title: ❄️ LIVE SNOW COVERAGE
source_name: NOAA/NCEP HRRR 3 km snow analysis (SNOD snow depth + SNOWC snow cover), hourly cycles
variable: SNOD snow depth (m) gated by SNOWC snow cover (%), analysis step: COLOR = confirmed snow on the ground
what: Snow physically present on the ground in Michigan. Falling snow, snowfall forecasts, precipitation, radar echoes, clouds, and uncertain detections are transparent. No snow means transparent — never a haze.
why_extreme: Rare deep accumulations compress into magenta/pink/white; ordinary depths own most of the color resolution. White is reserved for the extreme end.
